name: nckids-presenter
description: Presentation app for the NC Kids classroom: songs, lessons, videos and timers on the TV.
author: North Coast Family Fellowship

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: NC Kids Presenter uses the local network for the phone remote, so a phone on the same Wi-Fi can run the slides.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NC Kids Presenter only uses this to list speaker names, so you can send video sound to the TV. Nothing is recorded.
